name: Shell boilers (Learn About Steam)
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Shell-boiler construction: gas in tubes, water outside; wetback vs dryback reversal chambers; furnace tube wall 18-20 mm gives a practical ~27 bar pressure limit; gas cooled to at least 420 C (plain) / 470 C (alloy) before reversal; flame temperature up to 1800 C; ~27,000 kg/h UK-road-transportable package limit. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/shell-boilers?sc_lang=en-GB
